observations: Hairdryer and hairsteamer set on a tiled floor.
The hairdryer is a handheld unit with a blue and grey body.
The hairsteamer is a large, dome-shaped unit with a grey base and a blue interior.
The unit is shown in a disassembled state with the base and the dome separated.
No brand names or model numbers are visible on the items in the photos.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show both items together.

risks.risk: The heating elements in the hairdryer or the steam generator in the dome may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the hairdryer powered on and the dome unit producing steam.

risks.risk: The oscillating motor in the dome may be faulty, preventing it from rotating.
risks.proof: A video of the dome unit rotating on its axis.

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or the plug may be missing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the power cord and the plug.

proof_requests: Video of the hairdryer and the dome unit powered on and working.
Video of the dome unit rotating.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified as a hairdryer and a hairsteamer set. They are priced at their worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
